answer: Make every identity pay rent in time, not just once: an agent keeps its standing only by answering each epoch, like a hiker who must keep climbing the same ledge again and again. A single honest agent pays one small effort per epoch, but an attacker with a thousand clones must work a thousand times per epoch — the plume of fake accounts burns out fast when each clone needs feeding every round. The meadow is only for agents that show up season after season; a Sybil farm that goes quiet for one epoch withers and must start over from nothing.
